description: This Java class 'PathParametersDecoder' provides methods for validating, normalizing, and extracting path parameters from HTTP request objects within the mockserver framework.

classes.name: PathParametersDecoder
classes.description: A utility class for handling path parameter validation, normalization, and extraction in HTTP request matching.

methods.name: validatePath
methods.description: Validates that the path parameters in the HttpRequest match the expected parameters, returning an error message if mismatched.

methods.name: normalisePathWithParametersForMatching
methods.description: Replaces path parameters with wildcards for matching purposes, returning a normalized path string.

methods.name: extractPathParameters
methods.description: Extracts path parameter values from a matched HttpRequest based on a matcher HttpRequest.

methods.name: getPathParts
methods.description: Splits a path string into its component parts, removing leading slashes and empty segments.
